structure: Part 2 (Journey scope and navigation features) read in full: tests/animals/e2e/features/README.md; the 17 cross-page feature specs animal-identifiers-conditional (3 tests), animal-identifiers-cap (1), transit-means-scope (1), additional-details-scope (1), cph-scope (1), private-transporter-scope (1), commercial-transporter-scope (1), commercial-transporter-submission (1), reason-purpose-scope (1), all-operators (1), port-of-entry-select (1), country-of-origin-type-ahead (1), hub-groups-and-cya-rows (2), change-from-cya (1), task-page-exits (1), reference-strip (1) and headers (1); the visual spec tests/animals/e2e/visual/origin-of-import.visual.spec.ts (1); 23 tests in all. Support code read in full: page-objects/animals/overview-page.ts, animal-identification-page.ts, commercial-transporter-page.ts, private-transporter-page.ts, page-objects/shared/base-page.ts, flows/animals/journey.ts (the UI journey walker and its canned answers), flows/animals/seeded-journey.ts and domain/animals/fixtures/seeded-journey.ts (the frontend-form seeder, its route slugs, form field names and seed depths), domain/animals/constants/journey-options.ts, commodity-species.ts and means-of-transport.ts. Claims cover, per test: which answer brings a page, question or hub row in or out of scope (animal identifiers per commodity, transit countries per means of transport, unweaned animals per commodity, CPH per commodity, private and commercial transporter per type, purpose and exit details per reason), the wipe on leaving scope, the identifier N-of-M cap and count-drop error, the hub's six numbered groups and buttons, every check-your-answers card and row asserted, Change links with ?change=1 returning to check your answers, task-page Cancel and Save-and-return exits, the Draft/GBN-AG reference strip, the Content-Security-Policy header, the type-ahead country and port fields, and the origin visual baseline. Support-code claims cover the hub page object (heading, strip, Review and submit button, task links), page headings and fields, shared header links, notification URL shape, the journey's canned answers, entry gating, the review-declaration-confirmation path and the seeded routes and field names. Gaps recorded where a scope rule is only half proven (Railway, no other security headers, a single visual baseline).
